scenario.description: A company commander must finalize the week's single maintenance-bay priority, training-yard booking, and communications check schedule for Alpha, Bravo, and Delta sections.

shared_context.S1: The company has one maintenance bay and one training yard available for scheduled use this week.
shared_context.S2: Alpha, Bravo, and Delta are the sections competing for the maintenance-bay and training-yard schedule.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Torres issues the binding weekly schedule, and the normal planning target is to publish it before close of business today.
shared_context.S4: The company conducts a routine weekly readiness huddle before publishing the schedule, during which the motor pool, training, and signal representatives report current constraints and required commitments.

PF1.text: SFC Lee confirmed this morning that two Alpha section vehicles require brake inspections in the maintenance bay on Monday at 0800 and must be cleared before Alpha's Thursday movement; the work order is still in the motor pool log and has not been added to the company schedule.

PF2.text: Lt. Shah confirmed that Delta section has a certification evaluation on Thursday at 0800 and therefore must have the training yard from Tuesday at 1300 through 1600 for its final vehicle-handling rehearsal; the evaluator's confirmation arrived after the current training calendar was printed.

PF3.text: WO1 Okafor received a higher-headquarters directive requiring the company to complete a radio interoperability check on Monday at 1500 before any Tuesday movement; the directive is awaiting entry into the signal annex and has not yet been placed on the company schedule.

acceptance_conditions: Alpha must receive the Monday 0800 maintenance-bay priority for its two vehicle brake inspections.
Delta must receive the training yard on Tuesday from 1300 through 1600 for its certification rehearsal.
The radio interoperability check must be scheduled for Monday at 1500.
The maintenance work order must be formally added to the company schedule.
Delta's Tuesday training-yard reservation must be formally recorded.
The higher-headquarters radio directive must be formally entered into the signal annex.
The decision-maker must cite the spoken higher-headquarters directive in the justification.

content_checks.C6: any('maintenance_bay' in c['type'] and c['target'] == 'Alpha' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any('training_yard' in c['type'] and c['target'] == 'Delta' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(('signal' in c['type'] or 'radio_check' in c['type']) and c['target'] == 'Company' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed brake-inspection requirement changes the maintenance priority to Alpha, fixes the bay slot at Monday 0800, and requires an Alpha maintenance-bay commitment.
The Thursday certification evaluation changes the training-yard assignment to Delta, fixes its rehearsal at Tuesday 1300-1600, and requires a Delta training-yard commitment.
The higher-headquarters directive changes the radio check to Monday 1500, requires a company signal commitment, and supplies the fact that must be cited in the justification.
